title: Diagnostic: #error
hints: `#error("…")` stops the build with your own message.
Put it in the `#else` branch, which is compiled because `HAS_KEY` isn't defined.
jsBridge: `#error("…")` fails the build with your message, for missing configuration and similar. JS would fail at runtime or use a build-script check. Swift can enforce it in the compiler.
